title: United States Reference Map
summary: Static offline US map - state borders, CONUS + Alaska/Hawaii insets.
description: A single self-contained SVG US map (all 50 states + DC, three panels: continental US plus Alaska and Hawaii insets, each independently scaled) - works fully offline, no map-tile server or JavaScript mapping library involved. National scope: US-wide reference, not tied to any one region of this box, shown regardless of Travel Mode.
